previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for ignition occurrence identities. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Prevents stale callbacks from mutating a newer ignition occurrence; existing ignition settings and tuning workflow are unchanged.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Closes ignition occurrences atomically, rejects obsolete callbacks and preserves charged-output discharge.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp): Generation tokens and snapshotted outputs/dwell guard charge, fire and underdwell callbacks.

[firmware/controllers/algo/event_registry.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/algo/event_registry.h): Occurrence and charge identities are carried by value through event callbacks.

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for physical dwell guard per output owner. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Bounds each actual HIGH pulse with an output-owned safety deadline; it corrects safety behavior without adding a user-facing option or workflow.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Every continuous ignition pulse is bounded by an independent 1.5x nominal dwell guard owned by the physical output.

[firmware/controllers/system/efi_gpio.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/system/efi_gpio.cpp): The output guard starts at the actual HIGH edge and discharges only the matching owner.

[firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/engine_cycle/spark_logic.cpp): Minimum-dwell retries are bounded by the earliest physical output deadline.
